text:
jen: Quick sync — we need a concise rulebook for SI account wiring and claim behavior for marketplace + direct outreach. customers keep asking which SI ‘owns’ the pipeline and when we escalate. trying to avoid ad-hoc decisions. ideas below, please react or edit.

jen: Proposed high-level rules (draft):
1) If the SI brought the opportunity (existing invoice/contract evidence) => SI owns the initial outreach + demo cadence. Redwood supports enablement.
2) If Redwood-originated lead (platform usage, inbound PR) => Redwood owns but can assign co-sell if SI requests within 7 days with proof of engagement.
3) If both parties independently engage within 14 days => joint-ownership: split tasks (SI handles procurement/admin, Redwood owns technical POC).
4) For marketplace-sourced deals: default to SI ownership if purchase path routes through SI-managed listing; otherwise Redwood owns.
Edge cases: global accounts, reseller chains, OEM add-ons — escalate to @maria.

jen: Quick sample mapping snippet we can copy into SFDC intake form:
```
origin: [redwood|si|marketplace]
si_evidence: [doc_url|invoice|email]
joint_claim_window_days: 14
primary_owner: [redwood|si|joint]
escalation_owner: maria@redwood.com
```

tariq: +1 on the structure. one ask — add an explicit rule for demos paid vs unpaid. if SI fronts a paid pilot, they get priority ownership.

alex: Also suggest: a short checklist for handover so the buyer doesn’t get ping-ponged. like: 1) shared convo summary, 2) POC owner, 3) procurement path, 4) next step owner. keep it 4 bullets.

maria: I can take global accounts/edge cases. add an SLA: if claim dispute unreso­lved in 3 business days, ops will lock the account to the party with earliest documented outreach.

sam: FYI — marketplace purchases sometimes show up without SI metadata. ops needs a detection rule: if listing_id contains partner_ and partner_account present => auto-assign to SI. I'll file the rule.

jen: perfect. can someone summarize into a one-pager and a short intake form change? we should also add a note in partner portal. target: finalize by EOD Friday so sales/SEs have guidance next week.

tariq: I can draft the one-pager. will include flow diagram + the SFDC snippet. tagging @alex for checklist.

alex: will add the checklist and a 2-line blurb for playbook.

sam: filing the detection rule and will link the ticket here when created.

partner-bot: Created ticket PRT-4321: "Marketplace partner detection rule for SI auto-assign" assigned to sam, due 2024-07-12.

maria: adding SLA language to the doc. also propose weekly triage for disputes on Thursdays at 10am PT.

jen: love it. action items: tariq -> one-pager, alex -> checklist + blurb, sam -> ticket link, maria -> SLA + triage cadence. I'll collect and push to partner portal. :thumbsup:

tariq: ack. will have draft by Thursday noon.

sam: linking ticket once created. :gear:

alex: will review the SFDC intake fields with ops and get back.

maria: tagging legal to quick-approve the claim SLA language.

jen: thanks team — this will save a lot of friction. if anyone has a short customer example to add (who fought over ownership), drop it here and I'll anonymize.
